# SaaS Launch & SEO Snippets

Pure-YAML Espanso text-expansion snippets for founders and indie makers preparing a product launch. Contains zero shell commands or external scripts.

## Install

```bash
espanso install saascity-launch-snippets
```

## Triggers

| Trigger | Description |
|---|---|
| `:sl-ph` | Interactive form for a Product Hunt maker comment |
| `:sl-dir` | Structured startup directory submission template |
| `:sl-robots` | Modern `robots.txt` template with AI crawler rules (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Google-Extended`) |
| `:sl-og` | Open Graph and Twitter Card HTML `<meta>` tags |
| `:sl-utm` | Interactive UTM campaign URL builder (`utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`) |
| `:sl-schema` | `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD structured data template |
| `:sl-changelog` | Dated Keep-a-Changelog release entry (uses Espanso `date` var) |
| `:sl-launch-x` | 4-post launch announcement thread outline |
| `:sl-checklist` | Pre-launch technical SEO and QA checklist in Markdown |

## Related Tools

Free zero-signup launch utilities (including an interactive `robots.txt` generator and Domain Rating checker) are available at [saascity.io/free-tools](https://saascity.io/free-tools).
